svg.title: A live-trial alert appears as Cecil confronts three versions of one resident.
svg.desc: Three blank identity cards fan around Cecil's hovering stamp arm. As the Crosswalk raises the Mission score, Vale's tablet activates the live trial and Cecil asks which digital version should be told the other two are unreal.
